subject: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Value too long - can not quit JGR()

messages.author: 695eaec5c92d8703
messages.subject: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Value too long - can not quit JGR()
parts:
I have fresh install of JGR/Deducer when trying to quit get:

java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Value too long: a4,a4Base,a4Classif,a4Core,a4Preproc,a4Reporting,ABarray,abc,abind,aCGH, 
.... long list of more package names
at java.util.prefs.AbstractPreferences.put(AbstractPreferences.java:245)
at org.rosuda.JGR.toolkit.JGRPrefs.writePrefs(JGRPrefs.java:379)
at org.rosuda.JGR.toolkit.JGRPrefs.writeCurrentPackagesWhenExit(JGRPrefs.java:451)
at org.rosuda.JGR.JGR.exit(JGR.java:371)
at org.rosuda.JGR.JGRConsole.rReadConsole(JGRConsole.java:625)
at org.rosuda.JRI.Rengine.jriReadConsole(Rengine.java:471)
at org.rosuda.JRI.Rengine.rniRunMainLoop(Native Method)
at org.rosuda.JRI.Rengine.run(Rengine.java:640)

This appears to have been reported at one time in R-help: http://thr3ads.net/r-help/2007/06/977182-JGR-and-big-list-of-packages

Cheers,

Malcolm Cook
